components.name: Primary action
components.description: Theme-bound primary action, with hover, focus and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 400 12px/1.5 'Geist Mono', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; background: var(--sb-action); color: var(--sb-on-action); border: 1px solid var(--sb-action); border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--sb-action-hover); border-color: var(--sb-action-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sb-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Bordered action
components.description: Secondary action using the panel fill and raised hover surface.
components.css: .ds-bordered { font: 400 12px/1.5 'Geist Mono', system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--sb-panel); color: var(--sb-text); border: 1px solid var(--sb-line-strong); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-bordered:hover { border-color: var(--sb-dim); background: var(--sb-raise); } .ds-bordered:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sb-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-bordered:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Menu action
components.description: Compact unfilled chrome trigger; Base UI owns its popup behavior.
components.css: .ds-menu { font: 400 13px/1.5 'Geist Mono', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--sb-dim); background: none; border: none; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu:hover, .ds-menu[data-popup-open] { color: var(--sb-text); background: var(--sb-raise); } .ds-menu:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sb-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workspace field
components.description: The compact toolbar text field with the shared focus and caret treatments.
components.css: .ds-field { flex: 1; max-width: 560px; background: var(--sb-panel); color: var(--sb-text); border: 1px solid var(--sb-line-strong); border-radius: 0; padding: 7px 10px; font: 400 12px/1 'Geist Mono', monospace; accent-color: var(--sb-accent); caret-color: var(--sb-accent); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sb-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stage navigation
components.description: Current and idle stage states; labels and marks accompany color. The snippet is a visual sample of the CLI-backed navigation.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sb-line); } .ds-stage { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; flex: 1; min-width: 112px; min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 10px; background: none; border: none; text-align: left; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Geist Mono', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--sb-dim); cursor: pointer; } .ds-number { font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-name { font-weight: 500; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--sb-line); flex: none; } .ds-locked { border-style: dotted; } .ds-stage[aria-disabled='true'] { cursor: default; } .ds-stage[aria-current='step'] { color: var(--sb-on-current); background: var(--sb-current); } .ds-stage[aria-current='step']::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: calc(50% - 12px); bottom: 7px; width: 24px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; } .ds-stage:hover:not([aria-current='step']) { color: var(--sb-text); background: var(--sb-raise); } .ds-stage:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sb-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Command chip
components.description: The command-palette chip in title chrome.
components.css: .ds-chip { font: 400 12px/1 'Geist Mono', monospace; color: var(--sb-dim); background: var(--sb-panel); border: 1px solid var(--sb-line-strong); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--sb-raise); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sb-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status tag
components.description: Noninteractive metadata; semantic outcome variants use text and a matching border.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font: 400 12px/1 'Geist Mono', monospace; border: 1px solid var(--sb-line); color: var(--sb-dim); padding: 4px 6px; } .ds-tag.ds-style { color: var(--sb-accent); border-color: var(--sb-accent); } .ds-tag.ds-ok { color: var(--sb-ok); border-color: var(--sb-ok); } .ds-tag.ds-warn { color: var(--sb-danger); border-color: var(--sb-danger); } .ds-tag.ds-baked { color: var(--sb-warning); border-color: var(--sb-warning); }

components.name: Character card
components.description: Fixed-width card in the real empty-thumbnail state; identity labels are placeholders, with no character artwork.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 264px; padding: 0; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Geist Mono', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--sb-text); background: var(--sb-panel); border: 1px solid var(--sb-line); border-radius: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-visible { border-color: var(--sb-dim); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sb-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-thumb { width: 100%; height: 132px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sb-line); background: repeating-conic-gradient(var(--sb-check-a) 0% 25%, var(--sb-check-b) 0% 50%) 0 0 / 16px 16px; } .ds-no-thumb { font: 400 12px/1 'Geist Mono', monospace; color: var(--sb-well-text); } .ds-card-body { padding: 10px 12px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; } .ds-card-name { font: 500 28px/1.1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-card-id { font: 400 12px/1 'Geist Mono', monospace; color: var(--sb-dim); }

components.name: Reference well
components.description: Look's fixed dark reference well in its existing no-source-image state; no artwork is fabricated.
components.html: No source image for this character.
components.css: .ds-reference { height: 380px; border: 1px solid var(--sb-line); background: repeating-conic-gradient(var(--sb-check-a) 0% 25%, var(--sb-check-b) 0% 50%) 0 0 / 24px 24px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 16px; } .ds-note { font: 400 12px/1.5 'Geist Mono', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--sb-well-text); max-width: 32ch; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 6px; }

narrative.overview:
Imprint is a compact character workshop: condensed indigo headings, precise monospaced controls, fine crosshatch on the light workspace and sparse dither on blue-gray night surfaces. Solid panels keep the texture behind the work; reference images and saved sprites occupy dark, untextured wells.

The [public design guidance](../../docs/design/design-system.md) owns the shared visual commitments. This app-level record extracts the implemented system from [tokens](src/tokens.css), [type](src/fonts.css) and [styles](src/styles.css); those source files remain authoritative. [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) records product truth, while the [surface brief](.impeccable/surfaces/apps-studio-src-app-tsx.md) owns this screen's composition.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed display type paired with compact monospaced controls.
Square fields, thin rules and solid indigo actions.
Independent light/dark shells around unchanged sprite pixels.

rules.name: The Dark Well Rule
rules.body: Canvas wells use the shared checker and caption roles in both themes. Workspace texture stays outside images and canvases.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Ordinary panels use tone and thin borders. Menus and dialogs alone use the existing overlay shadows.

rules.name: The Saved Pixel Rule
rules.body: Recipe edits leave saved sprites unchanged until Bake. Display full saved cells at integer nearest-neighbor zoom; scrolling never trims or resamples them.

dos: Do consume semantic light/dark roles from tokens.css and preserve the shared well colors.
Do use the self-hosted display and UI faces with their existing fallback stacks.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, reduced motion, localization growth and inspector access.
Do keep outcome labels, the exact CLI twin, stale-frame cost and honest empty/error states.
donts: Don't invert the light palette to manufacture dark mode.
Don't place shell textures, filters or recoloring over sprite pixels.
Don't add decorative mascots, the rejected ASCII torus, notched buttons or entrance animation.
Don't present a changed recipe as newly baked output or browser resizing as mobile/native qualification.
